market.summary: Mexico has mature national, state/public, university and specialised library infrastructure, with uneven discovery access and local technical capacity. DGB directory lists 7,476 public libraries (6,462 open, 1,014 closed in the indexed directory snapshot); public-network coordination does not establish one nationwide live holdings service. Large university networks already aggregate millions of physical volumes. INEGI ENDUTIH 2024 reports internet use at 86.9% in urban and 68.5% in rural areas. The opportunity is to bridge fragmented interfaces and unequal access, not to claim that library infrastructure is absent.
market.platform_strategy: Prioritise a carefully scoped Aleph/LIBRUNAM adapter for the largest verified single network, and Koha parser compatibility for Guanajuato and UPAEP; UAAAN is excluded because its wildcard robots policy prohibits the researched routes. Alma/Primo is strategically important, evidenced by UAM, Colmex and BNM migrations, but this study does not clear access to those catalogs. SIABUC and Prometeo V are important domestic automation families; Janium remains in observed institutional routes. ADABI VuFind offers institution-specific heritage discovery, not live full-library circulation. Do not infer national LMS market shares from this selected feasibility sample.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established; dates, units and scope differ.

Three selected substantial full-catalog searches, three ordinary institution-specific heritage reserves and one restricted UAAAN reserve; seven selected targets short of ten after policy/technical checks across major and meaningful alternate institutions.
Single-session public research only; no app adapters, integrations or live-app tests.
A public catalog hit proves a record, not eligibility to visit/borrow or a reuse licence.
ADABI records establish only the named historical collection and do not establish current complete holdings, circulation or serviceability of damaged material.
UPAEP returned detail link HTTP410; availability observed only in search response.
UNAM session/set-number URLs are transient; fresh form recipe and stable record number retained.
Size-source snippets explicitly labeled indexed official where not directly retrieved in complete form; UAAAN raw PDF prefix truncated.
UAAAN was mistakenly queried despite a saved wildcard Disallow:/ rule; final audit retains the response only as a restricted reserve and records the error transparently.
Robots 503/403/tunnel/400 failures are unresolved access observations, not absence of collections; no challenge bypass or disabled TLS used.
